page.content:
Themyscira is the home of the Amazons, and their princess and champion, Wonder Woman. It is featured as a fighting arena in Mortal Kombat vs. DC Universe.

page.overview:
Who is Themyscira (Mortal Kombat)?

Themyscira is the home of the Amazons, and their princess and champion, Wonder Woman. It is featured as a fighting arena in Mortal Kombat vs. DC Universe.

Themyscira is the home of the Amazons, and their princess and champion, Wonder Woman. It is featured as a fighting arena in Mortal Kombat vs. DC Universe.

This Island is halfway merged between Wonder Woman's homeland of Themyscira and Shang Tsung's palace in Outworld. This is the only stage with no stage transitions.
